item.title: Wisconsin’s capital city cancels signature events, grapples with fallout from police shooting
item.description: A police shooting in Wisconsin’s progressive capital city this week put the spotlight on persistent and deep racial divisions, prompting cancellations and other changes to popular summertime events as protesters said they were determined to continue public pressure for change in Madison.
